phase_name: Snapshot Data Contract + Cockpit Source Registry + Liveness Heartbeat
goal: Wire the 14-key snapshot data contract, the Cockpit Source Registry (super-gsd/registry/cockpit-sources.yaml), the liveness heartbeat module (liveness.cjs), and the binding R19 conformance gate (gate.liveness.all-sources-fresh). Stub-and-fill — P139-P142 fill the stubs with real composition.

decisions.decision: 14 new keys land as stubs in P137. P139-P142 fill them with real composition. Lets the data contract become byte-stable before the components consume it.
cockpit-sources.yaml is the single source of truth. Both liveness.cjs and checkR19 read from it. No shape duplication between the heartbeat code and the conformance gate.

checkR19 returns ok:true for inputs without a _sources block (non-snapshot HTML, chronicle pages, synthetic fixtures). Prevents R19 from regressing SAC-P127-* and SAC-P134-03 while still firing strict-fresh on real snapshots.

All 6 tasks orchestrator-direct rather than via codex-executor.sh. Codex's Windows shell-exec block + repeated review-skill conflict (P128-T3 / P129-T3 / P134-T3) made the round-trip cost negative for content-locked work. P138+ tasks resume Codex routing where the verification loop is non-trivial.

SAC-P137-08 tightened from 'binding_fail = 0 on cockpit surface' to 'R19 = PASS on cockpit + monitor + cockpit-html'. Original phrasing hit pre-existing R01/R04/R07 chronicle-rule surface-wiring quirks unrelated to P137. SAC intent (R19 wiring) preserved.

deferred_items: Surface-wiring cleanup — R01/R04/R07 fire on 'cockpit' surface against bare JSON snapshots. Pre-existing quirk; not a P137 regression. Cleanup deferred to a future tidy phase or P143 conformance-promotion sweep.

consumers: v3.4/P138 (sticky chrome + SSE keep-alive + reconnect badge — fills data-conn="state" placeholder with _sources tier rollup)
v3.4/P139-P142 (component implementations consume the 14 new top-level keys)
constraints: 14 new top-level snapshot keys are FROZEN in shape per 137-CONTEXT.md §'Data contract field shapes'. Renames break SAC-P137-03/04. P139-P142 may extend with sub-keys but not rename top-level.
cockpit-sources.yaml is the single source of truth for liveness — checkR19 + liveness.computeLiveness both depend on it. Adding a new section requires a registry entry.
R19 is BINDING on cockpit-html/monitor/cockpit surfaces. Any snapshot that emits _sources with a non-fresh non-excused entry fails the gate.
attachAll() is the canonical composer. serve.cjs / cockpit-sidecar.run() must call attachAll() before emitting JSON or HTML once P138 lands the wiring.
extension_points: P138+ may add per-section liveness pill rendering inside renderShell sections — DOM hooks are reserved on every section via data-source attribute (P136)
P143+ may promote additional R* binding gates for the new key shapes; v3.4 INTENT scopes this

codex_runs.result: All 6 tasks orchestrator-authored — yaml registry, liveness module, attachAll + 13 stub attachers, R19 binding gate, 8 SAC tests, phase close. Codex skipped this phase due to Windows shell-exec block + content-locked task shape.
